🌐 DN42 全网实时动态拓扑 (Dynamic Network Topology)

targets.expr:
(
  max by (id, subTitle, role, is_controller, cpu_model, mem_total_gib, disk_total_gib) (
    label_replace(
      label_replace(
        (dn42_node_info or on(instance) dn42_node_meta_info),
        "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"
      ),
      "subTitle", "$1", "dn42_ip", "(.*)"
    )
  )
  or on(id)
  max by (id, subTitle, role, is_controller, cpu_model, mem_total_gib, disk_total_gib) (
    label_replace(
      label_replace(
        last_over_time(dn42_node_meta_info[7d]),
        "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"
      ),
      "subTitle", "$1", "dn42_ip", "(.*)"
    )
  )
)
or on(id)
max by (id, subTitle, role, is_controller, cpu_model, mem_total_gib, disk_total_gib) (
  label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(
    (max by (instance) (up{job="node"} == 1) or max by (instance) (0 * last_over_time(up{job="node"}[7d]))),
    "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"),
    "subTitle", "Node", "", ""),
    "cpu_model", "Standard Node", "", ""),
    "mem_total_gib", "-", "", ""),
    "disk_total_gib", "-", "", "")
)
or on(id)
max by (id, subTitle, role, is_controller, cpu_model, mem_total_gib, disk_total_gib) (
  label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(
    count by (target) (dn42_edge_rtt_ms or dn42_babel_link_rtt_ms),
    "id", "$1", "target", "(.*)"),
    "subTitle", "Babel Peer", "", ""),
    "cpu_model", "DN42 Peer", "", ""),
    "mem_total_gib", "-", "", ""),
    "disk_total_gib", "-", "", "")
)

max by (id) (label_replace(up{job="node"}, "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))
or
max by (id) (label_replace(0 * last_over_time(up{job="node"}[7d]), "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))
or on(id)
max by (id) (label_replace(dn42_edge_up == 1 or dn42_babel_link_up == 1, "id", "$1", "target", "(.*)"))

max by (id) (label_replace(dn42_node_cpu_percent or dn42_node_cpu_usage_percent, "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))
or
round(max by (id) (label_replace(100 * sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=~"user|nice|system|irq|softirq"}[1m])) / sum by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode=~"user|nice|system|idle|iowait|irq|softirq|steal"}[1m])), "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), 0.1)

max by (id) (label_replace(dn42_node_mem_percent or dn42_node_mem_usage_percent, "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))
or
round(max by (id) (label_replace(((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) * 100, "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), 0.1)

max by (id) (label_replace(dn42_node_mem_used_gib, "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))
or
round(max by (id) (label_replace((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes) / 1073741824, "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), 0.1)

max by (id) (label_replace(dn42_node_disk_percent or dn42_node_disk_usage_percent, "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"))
or
round(max by (id) (label_replace(((node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{mountpoint="/"}) / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"}) * 100, "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")), 0.1)

(

    (max by (id, dn42_ip, cpu_model, mem_total_gib, disk_total_gib) (dn42_node_info or on(instance) dn42_node_meta_info))

  label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(
    (max by (instance) (up{job="node"}) or max by (instance) (0 * last_over_time(up{job="node"}[7d]))),
    "id", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"
  ), "dn42_ip", "-", "", ""), "cpu_model", "Standard Node", "", ""), "mem_total_gib", "-", "", ""), "disk_total_gib", "-", "", "")
)
